title: 九月九日忆山东兄弟
pinyin: Jiǔ Yuè Jiǔ Rì Yì Shān Dōng Xiōng Dì
englishTitle: Remembering My Brothers in Shandong on the Double Ninth
author: Wang Wei

translation: alone in a strange land, a stranger among strangers
on every festival day i miss my family twice as much
from far away i know where my brothers climb the heights
and that one of us is missing as they all pin on the dogwood

appreciation: Wang Wei was only seventeen and far from home when he wrote this for the Double Ninth Festival. Instead of describing his own sadness, he imagines his brothers climbing the hill and noticing the one empty place among them. The poem matters because that reversed viewpoint makes the loneliness sharper and gave Chinese poetry its most famous line about missing family on a holiday.
